steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and credential thresholds for your background. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can verify your qualifications before enrollment, ensuring you meet all prerequisites to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions at your own pace while working full-time in Midland's energy, healthcare, or construction sectors. Our active certified practitioners deliver the curriculum online—no travel required—and you'll build the knowledge base PMI expects.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, submit your official PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on document preparation and submission to help you complete this step accurately and on schedule.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours. Sit for the computer-based PMP exam at a Pearson Vue testing center. Our preparation support is designed to reinforce bootcamp content and build confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, project work, and volunteer activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning options to help you stay current and renew your credential when the cycle completes.
